DataPropertyAssertion.Literal: The hand-written OWLlink tests of the early Konclude development (1a-SHIN ... 73-ALCOV): small TBoxes that exercise one description logic feature each (qualified number restrictions, inverse and transitive roles, role hierarchies, role chains, nominals, nominal schemas), with satisfiability, subsumption and instance queries. task=owllink: every BooleanResponse is checked against kt:expectedResult (one per response in document order, or a single one for all). Every expected result was confirmed with HermiT 1.4.5; requests that no reasoner answers within a minute (41_5..41_1000-ALCQ, 56-SIOQ-1000) are not included.
